senses.gloss:
Gakāra(ādi)gaṇapati(-gaṇeśa-)sahasranāma
stotra. 1000 names of Gaṇapati beginning with the letter ‘g’; assigned to Rudrayāmala in most of the mss. (Beg. gaNezvaro gaNAdhyakSo gaNArAdhyo gaNapriyaH). Also called Gaṇapati(Gaṇeśa) sahasranāma.
Adyar I. p. 211a (2 mss.). Adyar D. IV. 30 (nāmāvali). America 1894. 4551-53. 4557. Ānandāśrama 6393. Bd. 961. Bomb. Uni. 1441 (182 śls.). BORI. 1006 of 1884-87. 961 of 1887-91. 651 of 1895-1902. Dāhilakṣmī XXVII. 17. IM. 6906. IO. 8028. L. 889. Lz. 629 (nāmāvali). Mithilā. MT. 2078 (b). Pet. 724. Poona 389. PUL. I. p. 116 (with pañcāṅga). II. p. 176. Rgb. 1006. Trav. Uni. 4572A. 7774. 1587. 2493 (nāmāvali). Ujjain I. p. 83. II. p. 75 (2 mss.).
Nāmāvali. Pt.. in Pūjāsamuccaya. See also Gaṇapatisahasranāma.
